snippet.title: Miliastra Wonderland: Version 7.0 Legendary Set Teaser
snippet.description:
Master illusionists bent on "deceiving the very stars" once wore these formal costumes onto the most exalted stages, with gravitas and grace as much a part of the act as anything else.
*Manekin cosmetics and actions are for reference only. Please refer to the actual in-game appearance.
